name: Private Assistant
tag: An AI assistant that answers from your own files and notes and keeps them on your side.

scenarios.title: Ask questions about private files
scenarios.ask: Index {docs} internal documents and answer staff questions without sending the files to an outside service.
steps: Local indexer
Read {docs} documents, about {=docs * pages} pages, and built a search index stored on your server.
Search agent
Finds the most relevant passages for each question in about {=round(0.3 + docs * pages / 20000, 1)} seconds.
Answer agent
Writes a short answer and cites the document and page it came from.
Privacy guard
Keeps prompts, files and answers on your machine. Nothing is sent to a third party.
followups: How can it answer without an outside AI service?
It runs an open-weight language model on your own hardware. Answers may be a little less polished than the largest hosted models, but your data stays put.
The indexer watches the folder and re-reads changed files, usually within a few minutes.
Can I limit who sees what?
Yes. Answers respect folder permissions, so a person only gets answers from documents they are allowed to open.

scenarios.title: Keep a private notes journal
scenarios.ask: I write about {notes} notes a week. Organize them and give me a weekly digest, all kept on my laptop.
steps: Organizer
Tagged {=notes * weeks} notes by project and person and linked related ones.
Summarizer
Wrote a one-page digest of this week's notes with open questions at the top.
Reminder agent
Found {=max(1, round(notes * 0.15))} notes that mention a follow-up with no date and listed them.
Privacy guard
Stored everything in an encrypted local folder.
followups: Can I search old notes by meaning?
Yes. Ask a question like 'what did we decide about pricing in spring' and it finds the notes even if those words are not in them.
What happens if I lose the laptop?
The folder is encrypted. You can also back it up to a drive you control, and the assistant restores from that.

scenarios.title: Size the hardware
scenarios.ask: We want {users} people to use a private assistant with a {model} model. What hardware do we need?
steps: Sizer
A {model} model needs about {=model} GB of graphics memory to run at a comfortable speed.
Load planner
Planned for about {=ceil(users * 0.3)} people asking at the same moment.
Config agent
Suggested {=max(1, ceil(users * 0.3 / 4))} model worker(s) and a queue so nobody gets an error at busy times.
Cost agent
Compared buying one workstation with renting a private server.
followups: Is a small model good enough?
For search and summaries of your own documents, often yes. Larger models help more with long reasoning and writing.
Can we start small and grow?
Yes. Start with one worker and add more when the queue gets long. Your index and settings carry over.
